title: Felt the Virgin Mary's presence and guidance in Portugal

tellings.quote: related. This plus my encounter I'd had with her in Portugal, where I hadn't met her, but I felt her mind and thoughts.

plain: In Portugal in 1998, a man says he felt the presence of the Virgin Mary, sensing her mind and thoughts though he had never met her. The man, Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former senior officer of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, tells it as his own experience and ties it to other things that happened to him. If true, it would be a personal spiritual contact of the kind he links to his wider strange experiences.
